# Data sets 

We use the following data sets to validate findings from MB119: 

  - *in-vivo IM/Atrophy* data sets:
     - Nookaew et al., BMC Medical Genomics 2013. GSE27411. n=3 samples from non-infected patients (antrum and corpus) and unpaired samples from patients with atrophy (antrum and corpus). Illumina humanRef-8 v2.0 beadchip.
     - Companioni et al., PlosOne 2017. GSE78523. n=15 (11 Antrum, 4 Body). Affymetrix Human Almac Xcel Array
     - Thorell et al., Infection & Immunity 2017 (DOI: 10.1128/IAI.00031-17). E-MTAB-3689; n=25 RNA-Seq of gastritis, mild atrophy, extensive atrophy/IM
     
  - *in-vitro* data sets of stomach and intestine:
     - Colon (van Wetering et al.; DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2015.03.053) vs. Stomach (Bartfeld et al. Gastroenterology 2015. GSE60557. 2A/2C gland derived organoids). Both hybridized to Affymetrix Human Gene 2.0 ST Arrays. 
     - Kayisoglu et al. (Bartfeld lab, DOI 10.1136/gutjnl-2019-319919). GSE127938. 3 samples each from human stomach antrum + corpus ("stomach"), cranial intestine (duodenum, jejunum) and caudal intestine (ileum, colon) cultured as organoids and subjected to RNA-Seq
     - Zhenshou/China Small intestine vs. stomach
     
  - *ex-vivo* data sets of healthy and metaplastic stomach
     - Zhenshou/China IM vs non-IM 
     - MPIIB ESGIv2 IM vs. non-IM
     - MPIIB ESGIv2 IM vs. normal stomach
     
For each data set we compare Atrophy/IM vs. healthy/control conditions in stomach or large/small intestine vs. stomach samples.

# GSEA

```{r}
tmp = mapply(function(x, n) {x$comparison=n; return(x)}, all_gsea_results, names(all_gsea_results), SIMPLIFY = F)
gsea_df = do.call(rbind, tmp)
gsea_df[, sign_count:=sum(padj<0.2), by="pathway"]

gsea_df[, NES:=NES*ifelse(grepl("Kayisoglu", comparison), -1, 1)]
gsea_df[, ES:=ES*ifelse(grepl("Kayisoglu", comparison), -1, 1)]

table(gsea_df$sign_count, gsea_df$GeneSetCollection, dnn=c("N signif. comparisons","DB"))
```


### HALLMARK gene sets

```{r, fig.height=12, fig.width=12}
NES_mat = dcast(subset(gsea_df, sign_count >= 7), pathway + GeneSetCollection + sign_count ~ comparison, value.var="NES")

tmp = subset(NES_mat, GeneSetCollection=="HALLMARK")
mm = as.matrix(tmp[, 4:(ncol(tmp))])
rownames(mm) = tmp$pathway
colnames(mm) = old_to_new_comparison_names[colnames(mm)]
pheatmap(mm, main="HALLMARK gene sets enriched in at least 7 comparisons")
```

### MOTIF

```{r, fig.height=12}
NES_mat = dcast(subset(gsea_df, sign_count >= 7), pathway + GeneSetCollection + sign_count ~ comparison, value.var="NES")

tmp = subset(NES_mat, GeneSetCollection=="MOTIF")
mm = as.matrix(tmp[, 4:(ncol(tmp))])
rownames(mm) = tmp$pathway
colnames(mm) = old_to_new_comparison_names[colnames(mm)]
pheatmap(mm, main="MOTIF enriched in at least 7 comparisons")
```

  - targets of HNF4 -> high in both cranial and caudal intestine compared with stomach
  - targets of CDX2/PAX/EVI1/OCT/HOXA4/HOXA13/TCF4: high particularly in caudal intestines, less so in cranial. 

### MOTIFs, without MIRs

```{r, fig.height=12}
NES_mat = dcast(subset(gsea_df, sign_count >= 6), pathway + GeneSetCollection + sign_count ~ comparison, value.var="NES")

tmp = subset(NES_mat, GeneSetCollection=="MOTIF" & !grepl("^MIR|_MIR", pathway))
mm = as.matrix(tmp[, 4:(ncol(tmp))])
rownames(mm) = tmp$pathway
colnames(mm) = old_to_new_comparison_names[colnames(mm)]
pheatmap(mm, main="MOTIF enriched in at least 6 comparisons")
```

### MOTIF, selected gene sets

```{r, fig.height=12}
NES_mat = dcast(subset(gsea_df, sign_count >= 0), pathway + GeneSetCollection + sign_count ~ comparison, value.var="NES")

tmp = subset(NES_mat, GeneSetCollection=="MOTIF" & grepl("CDX|HNF4|PAX|EVI1|OCT|HOXA4|HOXA13|TCF4", pathway))
mm = as.matrix(tmp[, 4:(ncol(tmp))])
rownames(mm) = tmp$pathway
colnames(mm) = old_to_new_comparison_names[colnames(mm)]
pheatmap(mm, main="MOTIF, selected TFs")
```

### PATHWAY

```{r, fig.height=25, fig.width=20}
NES_mat = dcast(subset(gsea_df, sign_count >= 10), pathway + GeneSetCollection + sign_count ~ comparison, value.var="NES")
tmp = subset(NES_mat, GeneSetCollection=="PATHWAYS")
mm = as.matrix(tmp[, 4:ncol(tmp)])
rownames(mm) = tmp$pathway
colnames(mm) = old_to_new_comparison_names[colnames(mm)]
pheatmap(mm, main="PATHWAYS enriched in at least 10 comparisons", fontsize_row = 8)

```

  - higher in stomach: IFN-signaling, STAT3-signaling (why?)
  - higher in caudal/cranial intestine: HNF4A targets, FOXA2 (pioneering factor endoderm, aka HNF3B), APC/beta-catenin targets, cell cycle
  

### PATHWAYS, selected gene sets

```{r, fig.height=12}
NES_mat = dcast(subset(gsea_df, sign_count >= 0), pathway + GeneSetCollection + sign_count ~ comparison, value.var="NES")

tmp = subset(NES_mat, GeneSetCollection=="PATHWAYS" & grepl("CDX|HNF4|TCF4|IFN|catenin|STAT3", pathway))
mm = as.matrix(tmp[, 4:(ncol(tmp))])
rownames(mm) = tmp$pathway
colnames(mm) = old_to_new_comparison_names[colnames(mm)]
pheatmap(mm, main="PATHWAY, selected gene sets")
```
